criteria.description: Only accepted contacts appear in server mailbox; read cursors are account-scoped and monotonic.
Client uses shared summary SDK and falls back safely on older Social servers.
Windows and Android/Web live accounts show matching unread state and accurate read sync after interaction.
Migration 5 activates with accounts, contacts and prior messages intact.
Device opt-in and explicit capability negotiation never imply live registration before backend and distributor exist.
OS notifications, mobile resume and current chat/unread behavior work on target devices.
Scoped guest access and verified per-user principal prevent user spoofing and device impersonation.
Device API and WebSocket-ticket integration use LoopRD published routes, safe URLs and content-free wakes.
Actual LoopRD/ntfy and Windows/Android clients accept and validate sessions, device endpoint proof and recipient wakes.
LoopRD management role grants are explicitly declared and never expose password/token hashes.
Only verified trusted callers can broadcast admin events; recipient/role are always checked server-side.
Source release activates in LoopRD and an administrator can receive and dismiss/revoke a test event.
Native Windows remembered sessions go through a main-window-only encrypted device vault and never fall back to plaintext localStorage.
Windows upgrade migrates old sessions, authenticated restoration persists over temporary outages, and logout clears/revokes device sessions.
Windows build releases exactly the Cargo output exe before Tauri compilation, without stopping unrelated installed Tavi clients.
Real Windows ZipRunner build succeeds while previous development binary is running, preserves user state, and produces version 0.3.25 installer.
Saved credentials are cleared only after confirmed server rejection and never after temporary outages or 403 permission errors.
Retry scheduling and cancellation are bounded, coalesced and do not run after login or user switching.
A real Windows host can reconnect after loss of network without retyping the password.
Headless bridge supports isolated Tavi account, inbound cursor and send operations without leaked tokens.
OpenClaw operator accepts inbound DM and replies through bridge.

checks.description: Authenticated server mailbox, owner-only read cursor integration
assertions: Cross-device sessions share recipient read cursor.
Unaccepted contacts cannot read or advance cursors.
Schema migration only adds the new read table.

checks.description: SDK mailbox and client UX tests
assertions: Notification deduplication respects server read cursor.
Client uses only authenticated Social endpoint; old-server fallback persists.

checks.description: Cross-device user acceptance
checks.instructions: Sign in with one Tavi recipient account on Windows and Android or browser. Send a DM from another account. Confirm matching unread, then open it on one and verify the other clears after refresh; verify native chat window and notifications.

checks.description: Additive LoopRD schema rollout verification
checks.instructions: Back up production component database. Review/push generated looprd.yaml, deploy schema 5 and verify existing accounts, contacts, DMs and sessions survive. Test unauthorized DM read requests and confirm successful rollback planning.

checks.description: Local push preference/capability validation and foreground wakeup unit tests
assertions: Unexpected or missing backend capabilities do not enable background notifications.
Preference storage contains only opt-in state and is scoped to server+account.
Wake-up hints are bounded, content-free, deduplicated and require a signed-in client.
Foreground resume triggers a throttled authoritative server refresh.

checks.description: Windows and Android native OS notification and resume acceptance
checks.instructions: Import to existing looprd-social ZipRunner project, build Windows client and Android APK, sign in, test OS notification, suspend/resume Android and validate inbox refresh. Verify background status clearly says pending until LoopRD and UnifiedPush distributor integration exists; do not mark real push delivered.

checks.description: Verified principal, message recipient and rollback regressions
assertions: Guest scope cannot enroll devices or access private operations
Authenticated subject must match Social session
Failed durable event transaction rolls back message
Recipient wake uses only server-resolved principal ID

checks.description: Exact LoopRD push device API, verification, ticket and privacy checks
assertions: Authenticated bearer is sent only to same Social component
Device registration/verification/delete routes and payloads match LoopRD
Content-free wake schema rejects tokens and message bodies

checks.description: Real LoopRD, ntfy and client end-to-end acceptance
checks.instructions: Deploy compatible LoopRD runtime, enable push provider and install updated Tavi; verify guest signup, user login, push device challenge activation, accepted-friend DM wake, scoped denial and revocation. Confirm native closed-app Android push is not yet accepted.

checks.description: Ecosystem admin entitlement, service identity, fanout, revocation and rollback
assertions: Promote/revoke sources are explicit named operator actions.
Unprivileged sessions cannot self-promote.
Only private configured machine principals can invoke admin notification or role contracts.
Notification writes and recipient wakes occur in one SQL transaction.
Role revocation denies previously stored service-origin event access.

checks.description: Live LoopRD Data & actions and service contract smoke
checks.instructions: Push reviewed 0.3.24 source; reconcile LoopRD with management.data and service.contracts; back up DB and confirm schema6. Promote one test account in management panel, configure a mounted machine credential and calling-component dependency, publish one HTTPS-link notification, verify admin-only inbox and service-only authorization, revoke role, and check audit and removal of event access. Do not claim native closed-app Android delivery.

checks.description: Device vault adapter, WebView migration, no downgrade and session-only fallback
assertions: Windows persisted tokens are not written to WebView localStorage.
Existing remembered localStorage sessions migrate only after protected save succeeds.
Failed OS secure storage does not silently downgrade to plaintext.

checks.description: Main-only Tauri DPAPI command source guard
assertions: Only the main webview may access the vault commands.
Windows DPAPI protects per-user local app data and the implementation never emits credentials to a browser-visible storage API.

checks.description: Native Windows DPAPI, login and compact-Settings acceptance
checks.instructions: Build Windows client from ZipRunner with Rust/MSVC; verify close/reopen, migration, offline restore, sign out, vault denial from chat/game windows, and Settings scrolling. Native acceptance is not implied by source tests.

checks.description: Windows build helper is invoked before Cargo and targets only the exact executable path
assertions: Build invokes targeted helper before tauri build.
Helper matches process executable full path (not name alone) and requests graceful close before targeted forced stop.
Installer fallback remains intact and stop helper participates in build digest.

checks.description: ZipRunner rebuild with prior Tavi build-output executable running
checks.instructions: Run the target/release/looprd-social-client.exe produced by a previous version, import v0.3.25 in ZipRunner, and confirm TAVI_BUILD_STOP_* in build log, compilation/NSIS completes, previously installed Tavi elsewhere stays running, and no user configuration or database is changed. If Access denied persists, check antivirus or Windows ACLs.

checks.description: Classify auth recovery failures and validate bounded retry scheduling, cancellation and login hooks
assertions: HTTP 401 clears rejected credentials; HTTP 403 and transient statuses retain them.
Recovery retries are serialized with exponential 8–60s schedule and cancelled on manual account switching and authentication.
Startup login offers explicit saved-session retry and never fabricates offline Social identity.

checks.description: Windows DPAPI session resilience and live connectivity recovery
checks.instructions: Build v0.3.25 native Windows in ZipRunner. Save session, shut down, start offline, inspect Retry UI, reconnect and verify automatic server-authorized roster activation; verify 401 clearing, 403 retention, signout, different-account login, and independent chats. Native result unverified by producer.

checks.description: OpenClaw headless CLI and cursor tests
assertions: Inbound cursor filtering avoids duplicate delivery.
CLI help requires no credentials.
Missing server settings fail closed.

checks.description: Live Tavi/OpenClaw chat acceptance
checks.instructions: On an OpenClaw host, provision a dedicated Tavi account, run me, contacts and updates, then send and receive a DM using the bridge. Verify token isolation and no game-play claims.
